title: Make shapes an executable contract
steps: First ask whether a field is model geometry or a tunable performance knob.
Then derive the 12 QSA layers from the modulo rule; watch the zero-based numbering.
Finally check how layers tie to tensor shapes; never guess a type from its name alone.
challenge: Counterexample: writing 48 QSA layers makes the KV budget four times too large. An error in the safe direction is still an error.

title: Prove the update order with a one-dimensional example
steps: This is an excerpt of the math notes in the header file, not C++ you can compile.
Read down one column: decay → predict → residual → outer product.
The physical axis order of the state differs from the reference coordinates; β has already gone through sigmoid before the call.
challenge: Counterexample: updating first and decaying second gives a different finite number, and a NaN test will not catch it.

title: The selection budget is not the total cache capacity
steps: idx_top_k=2048 and idx_block=4, so the current interface width is at most 2051.
That is the amount of selection work this step, not a cap on how much history is kept.
The page table decides the physical location; logical indices should not change with residency.
challenge: Counterexample: if you permanently delete the pages that were not selected, a future query may lose information it should still reach.

title: Read the expected value out of the code
steps: run is the joint probability that every position so far was accepted.
e adds up 1 plus every prefix acceptance probability; same is the shortcut for equal probabilities.
The selector also divides by step_ms; optimizing e alone is not enough.
challenge: Counterexample: with p=1 the result must equal k+1; with p=0 it must equal 1.

title: The strict conditions on a prefix
steps: This is a fragment of conversation_prefix; the image identity check comes after it.
n must be strictly less than the new prompt length; the last token starts the verify window.
Do not cut out these three lines and claim that identical tokens are enough for reuse.
challenge: Counterexample: identical token placeholders with different images must not hit the same multimodal state.

title: Name the replacement policy correctly
steps: WAYS sets the associativity.
next rotates within a set; a hit does not update any recency order.
Do not call it LRU; the browser's modulo trace is a teaching simplification.
challenge: Counterexample: if all 9 keys land in one set, they can conflict even while other sets are empty.

title: Shared scratch and private state
steps: List each sequence's history from the fields other than the weights.
Different layers of one sequence can share a scratch buffer; that does not mean different sequences can share it concurrently.
When you add concurrency, recheck every reader, writer, lifetime and generation.
challenge: Counterexample: if interleaving A and B gives a different result from replaying each on its own, state isolation has failed.

title: The engine is a replaceable protocol boundary
steps: IDs go in and token IDs come out, so the protocol layer and the math layer can be separated.
MockEngine can test the API; it proves nothing about GPU kernels or language quality.
The top of the file states FIFO single sequence; count connections and execution streams separately.
challenge: Counterexample: five client threads that all wait in one queue are not five active generation streams.
